metadata.description: Security skills from zero-lab.ai for authorized assessment, detection, and engagement work

plugins.name: agent-security
plugins.description: Reviews agent and MCP surfaces, tests prompt-injection and runtime controls, and maps identity and authority across agent handoffs.

plugins.name: recon-operations
plugins.description: Provides authorized network, public-exposure, human, physical, and AI-system reconnaissance with explicit scope, contact, noise, evidence, and automation boundaries.

plugins.name: identity-security
plugins.description: Assesses Active Directory, AD CS, Kerberos, credentials, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and durable identity exposure while separating structural paths from demonstrated access.

plugins.name: application-endpoint-security
plugins.description: Tracks authorized security assessment coverage across web, cloud, mobile, firmware, endpoint persistence, and offline password auditing without turning missing evidence into clean results.

plugins.name: network-protocol-security
plugins.description: Plans and assesses wireless, network-protocol, traffic, command-channel, and bounded covert-channel security work with explicit scope, safety, evidence, and detection boundaries.

plugins.name: binary-forensics
plugins.description: Triages supplied binary faults, volatile-memory evidence, and suspected rootkits, and prepares bounded validation handoffs without execution or weaponization.

plugins.name: detection-validation
plugins.description: Builds and validates detections, audits telemetry coverage, tests defensive resilience, correlates incident evidence, and synthesizes control evidence without inflating coverage.

plugins.name: engagement-operations
plugins.description: Provides engagement planning, AI threat modeling, action-proof review, security-tool governance, findings writing, and report assembly with defensible evidence boundaries.

plugins.name: rag-security
plugins.description: Maps retrieval surfaces and assesses source integrity, tenant isolation, context handling, data exposure, and cleanup in RAG systems.

plugins.name: ml-system-security
plugins.description: Audits ML artifact lifecycles, decision boundaries, dataset integrity, and model-serving exposure with explicit evidence states.
